description.zh:
是否开启无活动暂停。取值范围如下：

- **true**：开启

- **false**（默认）：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable No-activity Suspension. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the feature.

- **false** (default): Disables the feature.
The ID of the scheduled task.

description.zh: 只读列存节点个数上限。取值范围：0～15。
description.en: The maximum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

description.zh: 只读列存节点个数下限。取值范围：0～15。
description.en: The minimum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.
The maximum number of PCUs. Valid values: 1 to 32.

description.zh: 最小值:0.25~32 PCU，且最小值 <= 最大值。单位：PCU。
description.en: The minimum number of PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs). Valid values: 0.25 to 32. This value must be less than or equal to the value of ScaleMax.

description.zh: 只读节点个数的伸缩上限0~15个可选, 且不能大于上限的值。取值范围：0~15。
description.en: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

description.zh: 只读节点个数的伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15。
description.en: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

description.zh: 无活动暂停的检测时长。取值范围：5~1440。单位分钟。检测时长必须是5分钟的倍数。
description.en: The detection period for No-activity Suspension. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 5 to 1440. The value must be a multiple of 5.
The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-up. Unit: percent. Valid values: 40 to 100.

description.zh: cpu弹降阈值。最小值:10~100 %，且最大值 - 最小值 >= 30
description.en: The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-down. Unit: percent. Valid values: 10 to 100. The value of ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold minus the value of this parameter must be greater than or equal to 30.

description.zh:
弹性灵敏度。取值：

- normal：标准
- flexible：灵敏
description.en:
The scaling sensitivity. Valid values:

- normal

- flexible
The start time. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-cron-job-policy-serverless --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cron-expression 0_0_13_0_0_0 --scale-min 1 --scale-max 12 --scale-ro-num-min 2 --scale-ro-num-max 4 --allow-shut-down true --seconds-until-auto-pause 10 --scale-ap-ro-num-min 1 --scale-ap-ro-num-max 1 --serverless-rule-cpu-enlarge-threshold 80 --serverless-rule-cpu-shrink-threshold 25 --serverless-rule-mode normal --start-time 2020-09-23T01:00:00Z --end-time 2020-02-12T15:00Z --job-id 8006e51c-dab3-4602-bc69-4f728002c6ce --region cn-hangzhou
